tests.boundary: memory state vs predictive latent state
tests.evidence: MEM-02 episode latent and semantic parameters remain memory/model representations; PRD-03 posterior latent-state belief is state estimation, not episodic storage.

MEM-02 semantic-model parameters, PRD-01 SR/PR parameters, SKL-01 forward/inverse parameters and SKL-02 recurrent weights remain source-defined learned structure; none is auto-promoted to active coordinator.
MEM-01/MEM-03 retrieval queries read retained memory; PRD-01/PRD-03 predictive/state-estimation operations compute consequences/posteriors. Shared mathematical readout form is not family identity.
SKL-01 inverse controller and SKL-03 aim-cache/exploration are source-defined skill/action mechanisms; P_out execution/query interface does not itself become a persistent policy.
None of the nine central models requires offline replay to be reclassified as an online planner; M3 introduces no replay coordinator.

tests.boundary: learned transition model vs episodic trace
tests.evidence: PRD-01 learned occupancy/transition-related representations and PRD-03 experiment-defined HMM transition structure are not episodic traces; MEM retained traces/codes remain separately typed.
MEM-02 delayed compression variants do not establish within-trace consolidation; SKL source-defined online execution/plasticity is not inferred from offline delay schedules.
PRD-01 TD error and SKL-01 forward/control errors are transient source-defined update signals, not persistent prediction/coordinator state.
PRD-01/PRD-03/SKL-02/SKL-03 task histories and trajectories remain outside; only source-defined learned beliefs/weights/caches are internal.

conclusion: M3 preserves source-specific boundaries; no cross-domain homogenization is used to obtain A0 fidelity.
